product.name: NextUI React UI Library
product.description: A React-based UI component library built on Tailwind CSS for creating websites and applications with customizable themes and accessibility features.

product.name: NextUI Accordion Component
product.description: A React component that displays expandable and collapsible list items with customizable styles and accessibility support.

product.name: NextUI Autocomplete Component
product.description: A React component combining a text input with a listbox to filter and select options, supporting asynchronous loading and custom filtering.

product.name: NextUI Badge Component
product.description: A React component that displays small numerical values or status descriptors attached to UI elements with customizable appearance.

product.name: NextUI Calendar Component
product.description: A React component for displaying and selecting dates with support for multiple calendar systems, navigation, and accessibility.

product.name: NextUI Checkbox Component
product.description: A React component that allows users to select one or more options with support for indeterminate state and accessibility.
